items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: Well, I like Teddy Wilson, but I think Art Tatum was the best.

ctx.x: Who would be the best pianist that you ever heard? Did you have a favorite? Did you have a favorite? Maybe your brother or anybody else? Or who would have been the greatest player you ever heard?
Well, I like Teddy Wilson, but I think Art Tatum was the best. I like Art Tatum a lot.
Of the fellows down here, who would be the best that you ever heard? Around here?
